name: Hazard Crew
source:
A dark crime chat simulation game where you work as a cleaner for a powerful mafia family to pay off the debt left behind by your now-cured illness.

[From [url=https://chanchangames.itch.io/hazard-crew]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款黑暗犯罪题材的聊天模拟游戏。你的重病虽已痊愈，却留下了巨额债务；为了还清欠款，你不得不受雇于一个势力庞大的黑手党家族，担任善后处理的“清道夫”。

[摘自[url=https://chanchangames.itch.io/hazard-crew]itch.io[/url]]
